retrievalProfile.description: A framed photographic portrait set within a heavy red border featuring stacked, high-impact sans-serif typography and graphic directional lines.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central photographic scene of a couple in a wooded area, framed by a thick red outer border and a thin black-and-white inner line. The top third is dedicated to heavy, multi-colored sans-serif text, while a small white call-out box sits on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy header balanced by a centered photographic subject
Vibrant red border containing a high-contrast white inner field
Graphic arrows connecting the top title to the central image area
Naturalistic green and brown tones in the photo contrasting with the flat primary red border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, flanked by large tree trunks that act as natural vertical pillars.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored artist name in the upper center serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, move down the graphic arrows to the central portrait, then to the call-out box on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is used as a buffer between the text elements and the photographic frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (Background for text and inner frame)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and text elements contrasts with the muted, naturalistic tones of the central photograph.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is smaller and centered between the two main names
The 'E' in the bottom name features a horizontal bar above it
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying colors (Grey, Blue, Green) within the same font family to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal line with right-angle downward arrows
Rectangular call-out box with thin black border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque weight and squareness
Provides the necessary vertical density and tight spacing

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a central square photograph of a couple in 1960s attire standing between two large trees in a forest. Surround this image with a thin white and black border, then a very thick solid red outer frame. Leave the top 30% of the white area empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered, ultra-bold uppercase sans-serif text in the top white section. Use grey for the first line, blue for the second, and green for the third. Add a black horizontal line with downward arrows at the ends above the photo. Place a small white box with black text on the left side of the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border a solid, vibrant red?
Are there graphic arrows pointing down from the header?
Is the text stacked and ultra-bold?
Is the central photo framed by trees?

adjustableVariables: Text content in the call-out box
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red border is thick and uniform.
Verify the arrows are perfectly horizontal and vertical.
Check that the text is tightly tracked and centered.
Confirm the photo looks like a vintage 1960s print.
recipe.reuseFormula: Thick [Color] Border + Stacked [Font Category] Header + [Graphic Element: Arrows] + Framed [Subject] Photo
